messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "50 mg every 6 hours for 48 hours, starting 15 minutes after the last dose given into a vein"
set: ["50 mg every 6 hours for 48 hours, starting 15 minutes after the last dose given into a vein", "given as a bolus infusion over 15 minutes", "given in vein", "after titration, 50 mg to 100 mg can be taken every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain", "subsequent doses given every 12 hours", "increase should be given no sooner than 6 to 8 hours after the previous dose", "common starting dose is one 50 mg tablet a day", "injected into a vein by a healthcare provider", "first dose infused over 15 minutes", "use the mixture within 15 minutes", "taken every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain", "first parenteral dose infused over 15 minutes", "15 to 30 minutes", "subsequent doses given 4 and 8 hours after first dose", "given as a single dose or split into two doses", "usual starting dose for edema is 100 mg a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
